_comments.firefox: Selected because it is used frequently and benefits from newer browser features. This freshness choice is not a security claim; stable Firefox also receives upstream security updates.
_comments.codex-desktop: Frequently and deeply used; prefer current stable desktop features. Native and Sandbox follow matching Community source heads with exact successful publisher checks.
_comments.codex-cli: Frequently and deeply used; prefer current tested Nixpkgs unstable features. Protected deployment reviewer is independently pinned and is not upgraded by this policy.
_comments.holds: Add an exact immutable pin, a reason and optional first allowed stable resumeAtVersion. Omitting/null threshold means indefinite; no date or Git revision automatically releases a hold. Kando preserves its existing 2.3.0 adapter requirement.
_comments.ordinaryHolds: Nixpkgs package attribute (e.g. kando), or codex-cli for codex: pin is a full Nixpkgs revision, reason required, resumeAtVersion is the first acceptable numeric stable version. Default source nixpkgs; Firefox/Codex CLI use packageSources. Null means indefinite.
_comments.desktopHolds: Community pin={native:<revision>,sandbox:<revision>}; deliberately update both matching flake.lock pins when adding a downgrade. Evaluation rejects mismatches, so a hold cannot be silently overwritten.
_comments.patches: Temporary bug fixes: package attribute -> reason, patchFiles [config/update-patches/name.patch], optional removeAtVersion (first version without patch), optional source. Null/omitted threshold keeps the patch. Feature patches stay next to their application module. See docs/UPDATES.md for examples.

kando.reason: The existing Kando schema/gesture adapter explicitly requires 2.3.0. Preserve that compatibility pin during unattended system updates; remove after validating a newer adapter.
